fortunes.text: You will be loved the way you need, but not by who you expected.
The crush you're hiding is obvious to everyone but you.
A stranger's kindness will feel like a love letter.
The love you're looking for is looking for you too.
You will be asked to dance. Say yes before you think.
The chocolate you receive will be the wrong kind. Eat it anyway.
This year, you will learn the difference between being alone and being lonely.
The poem you write tonight will be the one you remember.
You will be surprised by who remembers your name.
The flower you receive will wilt. The gesture won't.
You are lovable exactly as you are. Stop auditioning.
A kiss you give tonight will be remembered longer than you think.
The love you've been waiting for is already here. You keep looking past it.
You will be given a second chance at first love. Take it.
The person you're pining for is pining for someone else. That's not rejection. That's redirection.
You will fall in love with someone's voice before their face.
The heart you're protecting is protecting you. Let it out.
This year, you will understand why the heart breaks. It's not for the pain.
You will be asked to choose between being safe and being loved. Choose loved.
The love you've been running from is the love you need most.
You will out-love someone, and it will cost you. Love anyway.
The person you're looking for is looking for you. You're standing back to back.
You will be loved the way you love, not the way you asked. Pay attention.
The love you've been waiting for is actually waiting for you to love yourself first.
You will break someone's heart this year. Do it gently.
The love of your life is someone you've already met. You haven't realized it yet.
You will be loved the way you need, but not by who you expected. That's the point.
The love you're looking for is actually looking for you. You're standing back to back. Turn around.
You'll eat too much chocolate. That's the point of the holiday.
The rose you receive will have thorns. That's the point of the flower.
A new love begins tonight. You'll be the one who starts it.
The love you accumulate will mean nothing. The love you distribute will mean everything.
This Valentine's Day, you will understand why the heart needs the break. Both are necessary. Both are yours.
